messages:
Lena: Heads-up  prepping the marketplace listings for AWS/GCP/Azure. Uploaded draft asset zip + initial manifest. Need quick sanity check on compliance copy + AMI/image refs.
Omar: Looking. Do we have final meter IDs? Finance flagged naming must be RW-<cloud>-<tier>-<region>.
Priya: We only have RW-AWS-basic-usw2 as a stub. Need enterprise SKU format too.
Ben: infra: AWS AMI will be done tonight (ami-0d1f2e3c). GCP image path: projects/redwood-global/images/rw-2026-03-21. Azure VM image still pending.
Sofia: Legal note  marketplace listings in EU require local EULA snippet + data residency checkbox if you claim EU-only hosting. Don't claim EU residency unless onboarding verified.
Lena: Good catch. I'll mark EU residency false for now and add an action to revisit after private-deploy verification.
Omar: For telemetry endpoints, we need region-aware endpoints to avoid cross-region calls from marketplace instances. Manifest should include telemetry_endpoint per SKU.
Lena: I'll add a mapping. Example: `rw-telemetry.eu -> telemetry.eu.redwood.ai` in manifest.
Priya: UX: tile images need alt text and a short tagline under 80 chars. Also, trial messaging must use exact phrase in billing portal. Which trial length are we shipping?
Ben: Product set to 14-day trial for the GA bundle. Confirmed.
Sofia: Legal: send me the promo terms PDF and the localized EULA snippet. I'll draft the Azure privacy checklist too.
Lena: Attached files: `assets/tiles.zip`, `manifest-marketplace.yml`, `promo-terms.pdf`.
MarketplaceBot: Checklist created: checklist/3623456789-marketplace-preflight. Owners: Ben (images & images refs), Omar (SKUs & metering), Sofia (legal & privacy), Priya (copy & tile alt text).
Omar: Metering stub added to manifest:
```
skus:
  - id: RW-AWS-BASIC-USW2
    meter_id: meter-aws-basic-0001
  - id: RW-GCP-BASIC-EU
    meter_id: meter-gcp-basic-0002
```
Priya: Copy note  avoid "enterprise-grade" on marketplace listing without product team signoff. Use "production-ready" instead.
Ben: Infra ETA for Azure image: tomorrow 10:30 PT. If delayed, we can submit AWS+GCP and add Azure in second pass. Need approval from partnerships for staggered publish.
Lena: Staggered publish ok but call it out in the submission notes. Also include support email and escalation matrix on each listing.
Sofia: One more legal: reseller/ISV program mention requires partner authorization. Do not reference partners unless we have explicit permission.
Priya: I'll remove partner references from copy.
Omar: Finance: pinged to confirm meter IDs and max price caps.
Ben: Quick technical snippet for manifest (so marketplace team can route correctly):
```
offer_id: redwood-inference-ga
routing:
  us-west-2: aws
  europe-west1: gcp
  westeurope: azure
```
Lena: Nice. Action items recap: Ben finalize Azure image or confirm staging plan; Omar finalize meter IDs + pricing caps; Sofia finalize localized EULA + privacy checklist; Priya finalize alt text + remove partner mentions; Lena will assemble final submission package. Target internal sign-off 17:00 PT tomorrow. :spiral_calendar: :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Omar: I'll have metering list by 12:00 PT.
Sofia: Legal will prioritize EU docs and upload comments by noon.
Priya: Copy pass done by 15:00 PT.
Ben: Will update AMI/image refs as soon as infra confirms.
Lena: Thanks all. If blockers pop up, drop here and we'll triage. :thumbsup:
